name: State codec
threading: Pure functions; thread-safe. Not real-time safe (allocates).
platforms: Any C++17 compiler. No dependencies, not even `chop_contracts` (it carries its own private `Result` type).
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/state_codec -B build/state_codec && cmake --build build/state_codec && ctest --test-dir build/state_codec
summary: Versioned project container. Each stateful module serializes its own payload; this module composes them under module ID + schema version with a CRC, validates every size before allocating, and chains registered migrations.
limits: 64 MiB total, 48 MiB per payload, 32 modules, 64-character module IDs (implementation defaults; the maximum serialized source size is an open spec decision)
adapters: Your host's save/restore callbacks hand the byte blob to `decode()` / receive it from `encode()`.
adapter_notes: Keep file dialogs and host project callbacks in your application; this module only sees byte vectors.
removal: Delete the folder; callers lose project-state composition only.
